pages.text: Only one spot on the sandy shore had shade. A wooden boat lay upside down there. Sitting beside it was cool.
"I'll go first and save our spot!" Taro ran ahead. Mumu would come after eating.
Beside the boat, Taro drew an arrow in the sand for Mumu to follow. "They'll know right away."
Suddenly the sky darkened, and rain poured down. Taro slipped under the boat.
Rat-a-tat-tat. Rain drummed on the boat. Taro sat hugging his knees.
The rain stopped. Mumu arrived at the shore. Nothing was drawn in the sand.
Mumu looked around. No one seemed to be there. Mumu started to turn back.
Taro peered out from beneath the boat. He saw long legs! "Mumu!"
Mumu looked underneath. Taro was curled up inside. "There you are!"
Three stones stood in the sand now. Rain could not wash those away. It poured again. Beneath the boat, the friends watched the stones and laughed.
